sinweapons.ability.black_axe_of_sloth.st: Foes within 5 blocks (up to 8) are frozen in place for 2 seconds (Slowness VII). Cooldown 14 s.
sinweapons.ability.black_axe_of_sloth.cr: A crushing slam: foes within 4.5 blocks (up to 8) take 10 damage and are driven to the ground. Cooldown 10 s.
sinweapons.ability.black_gunblade_of_env: Four green eyes open along a line 20 blocks long: up to 4 foes on it glow and weaken for 6 s, and up to 3 beneficial effects are taken from them and lent to you (10 s at most). Cooldown 12 s.
Green wisps drain foes within 5 blocks (up to 4) for 7 damage each, and you recover 1.5 health per foe (6 at most). Cooldown 12 s.
sinweapons.ability.black_spear_of_vanity: A thrust and its reflection: a line 8 blocks ahead of you and 8 behind you hits up to 6 foes for 9 damage each. Cooldown 5 s.
A mirror of self-love: foes in a cone 8 blocks ahead (up to 6) are weakened for 5 s and slowed for 3 s as they stare at themselves. Cooldown 13 s.
sinweapons.ability.black_chakrams.thrown: Both rings fly out 14 blocks and come back: up to 4 foes on the line take 10 damage. Cooldown 5 s.
sinweapons.ability.black_chakrams.bindin: The rings close round foes within 4.5 blocks (up to 6): they are slowed and weakened for 4 s and pulled towards you. Cooldown 10 s.
sinweapons.ability.seifort_holy_sword.pu: A column of light: you are cleansed of harmful effects, the undead within 6 blocks (up to 8) take 10 damage (x1.5 against them) and other foes glow for 5 s. Cooldown 12 s.
sinweapons.ability.seifort_holy_sword.ho: Sacred ground within 5 blocks: you recover 6 health and regenerate for 5 s, foes (up to 8) are pushed back and the undead take 8 damage (x1.5 against them). Cooldown 15 s.
sinweapons.passive.black_axe_of_sloth.de: A plain hit on a creature that is already slowed slows it deeper (Slowness II) and longer (3 s).
sinweapons.passive.black_gunblade_of_env: A plain hit makes the creature glow for 3 s.
sinweapons.passive.black_spear_of_vanity: A plain hit gives you Absorption I for 4 s (at most every 3 s).
sinweapons.passive.black_chakrams.desc: A plain hit heals you for half a point of health (at most every 1.5 s).
sinweapons.passive.seifort_holy_sword.de: A plain hit sets the undead on fire for 4 s.
sinskill.msg.abilities_off: The extra techniques are switched off on this server.
